span.p: 3D = Vector3 / Quaternion. 2D = the same type with the extra axis omitted (Vector2 in, z = 0). Names: Object2d/Object3d, Node2d/Node3d, Sprite2d/Sprite3d, Scene2d/Scene3d, World2d/World3d, Camera2d/Camera3d.

span.p: Scenes generate themselves. The generator creates and generates them (createScene / generateScene). No bakeScene on the generator.

span.p: The non-runtime surface ships in the same SDK under the Core subpath. No separate math SDK.
